verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt specific to skills.sh. The only llms.txt probe hit is GitHub's own file, and the skills.md docs probe returned 404. Agent-oriented docs do exist: an AGENTS.md in the vercel-labs/skills repo lists the CLI commands, and agentskills.io publishes its specification as raw markdown (specification.md) that an agent can read. Missing for 10: a skills.sh llms.txt or llms-full.txt, markdown versions of the docs pages, any statement that AGENTS.md is meant for end-user agents, and independent confirmation that agents use these docs.
